gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: The flight was delayed ___ thick fog.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of' + noun phrase gives the cause; although/despite express contrast.

gaps.sentence: ___ his leg was strapped up, the captain insisted on playing.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' intensifies the concession before a full clause.

gaps.sentence: I will send the report today ___ you asked for it early.
The plane was delayed; ___, we missed the connection.
The prototype is undeniably elegant; it is, ___, hopelessly impractical.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' concedes elegance while introducing the drawback.

gaps.sentence: It sounds ___ the negotiations are close to a breakthrough.
gaps.explanation: 'It sounds as though...' reports an impression.

gaps.sentence: Far from resenting the changes, the staff welcomed them; ___, productivity rose.
gaps.explanation: Rising productivity is an additional point in the same direction: moreover.
